content_items.arabic_text: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ
فِي اوْلِيَائِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَخْلَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ وَدِينِكَ
إِِذِ ٱخْتَرْتَ لَهُمْ جَزِيلَ مَا عِنْدَكَ
ٱلَّذِي لاََ زَوَالَ لَهُ وَلاَ ٱضْمِحْلاَلَ
وَسَالَكَ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ فَاجَبْتَهُ
وَجَعَلْتَ لَهُ مِنْ اخِيهِ رِدْءاً وَوَزِيراً
لَوْ لاَ ارْسَلْتَ إِِلَيْنَا رَسُولاًَ مُنْذِراً
فَنَتَّبِعَ آيَاتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ انْ نَذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
إِلَىٰ انِ ٱنْتَهَيْتَ بِٱلامْرِ إِلَىٰ حَبِيبِكَ وَنَجِيبِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ
وَوَعَدْتَهُ انْ تُظْهِرَ دِينَهُ عَلَىٰ ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِ
وَذٰلِكَ بَعْدَ انْ بَوَّاتَهُ مُبَوَّا صِدْقٍ مِنْ اهْلِهِ
وَقُلْتَ «إِِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ
وَقُلْتَ «مَا سَالْتُكُمْ مِنْ اجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ.»
إِلاَّ مَنْ شَاءَ انْ يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلاًَ.»
اقَامَ وَلِيَّهُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ ابِي طَالِبٍ
وَقَالَ: ”مَنْ كُنْتُ انَا نَبِيَّهُ فَعَلِيٌّ امِيرُهُ.“
فَقَالَ لَهُ: ”انْتَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَىٰ
وَاحَلَّ لَهُ مِنْ مَسْجِدِهِ مَا حَلَّ لَهُ
وَلاَ يُلْحَقُ فِي مَنْقَبَةٍ مِنْ مَنَاقِبِهِ
وَلاَ تَاخُذُهُ فِي ٱللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
وَقَتَلَهُ اشْقَىٰ ٱلآخِرِينَ يَتْبَعُ اشْقَىٰ ٱلاوَّلِينَ
إِِلاَّ ٱلْقَلِيلَ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ لِرِعَايَةِ ٱلْحَقِّ فِيهِمْ
فَعَلَىٰ ٱلاطَائِبِ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّد وَعَلِيٍّ
ٱلَّتِي لاََ تَخْلُو مِنَ ٱلْعِتْرَةِ ٱلْهَادِيةِ
ايْنَ مُسْتَاصِلُ اهْلِ ٱلْعِنَادِ وَٱلتَّضْلِيلِ وَٱلإِلْحَادِ
ايْنَ بَابُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي مِنْهُ يُؤْتَىٰ
ايْنَ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي إِِلَيْهِ يَتَوَجَّهُ ٱلاوْلِيَاءُ
ايْنَ ٱلسَّبَبُ ٱلْمُتَّصِلُ بَيْنَ ٱلارْضِ وَٱلسَّمَاءِ
ايْنَ ٱلطَّالِبُ بِذُحُولِ ٱلانْبِيَاءِ وَابْنَاءِ ٱلانْبِيَاءِ
ايْنَ ٱلْمَنْصُورُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَٱفْتَرَىٰ
ايْنَ ٱلْمُضْطَرُّ ٱلَّذِي يُجَابُ إِِذَا دَعَا
ايْنَ صَدْرُ ٱلْخَلاَئِقِ ذُوُ ٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
يَا بْنَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي امِّ ٱلْكِتَابِ لَدَىٰ ٱللَّهِ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
لَيْتَ شِعْرِي ايْنَ ٱسْتَقَرَّتْ بِكَ ٱلنَّوَىٰ
بَلْ ايُّ ارْضٍ تُقِلُّكَ اوْ ثَرَىٰ
ابِرَضْوَىٰ اوْ غَيْرِهَا امْ ذِي طُوَىٰٰ
عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ ارَىٰ ٱلْخَلْقَ وَلاَ تُرَىٰ
وَلاَ اسْمَعُ لَكَ حَسِيساً وَلاَ نَجْوَىٰ
عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ تُحِيطَ بِكَ دُونِيَ ٱلْبَلْوَىٰ
وَلاَ يَنَالُكَ مِنِّي ضَجِيجٌ وَلاَ شَكْوَىٰ
بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ مُغَيَّبٍ لَمْ يَخْلُ مِنَّا
بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ نَازِحٍ مَا نَزَحَ عَنَّا
بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ عَقِيدِ عِزٍّ لاَ يُسَامَىٰ
بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ اثِيلِ مَجْدٍ لاَ يُجَارَىٰ
بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ تِلاَدِ نِعَمٍ لاََ تُضَاهَىٰ
بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ نَصِيفِ شَرَفٍ لاََ يُسَاوَىٰ
إِلَىٰ مَتَىٰ احَارُ فِيكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ وَإِِلَىٰ مَتَىٰ
وَايَّ خِطَابٍ اصِفُ فِيكَ وَايَّ نَجْوَىٰ
عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ اجَابَ دُونَكَ وَانَاغَىٰ
عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ ابْكِيَكَ وَيَخْذُلَكَ ٱلْوَرَىٰ
عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ يَجْرِيَ عَلَيْكَ دُونَهُمْ مَا جَرَىٰ
هَلْ مِنْ مُعِينٍ فَاطِيلَ مَعَهُ ٱلْعَوِيلَ وَٱلْبُكَاءَ
هَلْ مِنْ جَزُوعٍ فَاسَاعِدَ جَزَعَهُ إِِذَا خَلاَ
هَلْ قَذِيَتْ عَيْنٌ فَسَاعَدَتْهَا عَيْنِي عَلَىٰ ٱلْقَذَىٰ
هَلْ إِِلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ احْمَدَ سَبِيلٌ فَتُلْقَىٰ
هَلْ يَتَّصِلُ يَوْمُنَا مِنْكَ بِعِدَةٍ فَنَحْظَىٰ
مَتَىٰ تَرَانَا وَنَرَاكَ وَقَدْ نَشَرْتَ لِوَاءَ ٱلنَّصْرِ تُرَىٰ
اتَرَانَا نَحُفُّ بِكَ وَانْتَ تَؤُمُّ ٱلْمَلَا
وَنَحْنُ نَقُولُ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
فَاغِثْ يَا غِيَاثَ ٱلْمُسْتَغِيثِينَ عُبَيْدَكَ ٱلْمُبْتَلَىٰ
وَبَرِّدْ غَلِيلَهُ يَا مَنْ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
اَللَّهُمَّ وَنَحْنُ عَبِيدُكَ ٱلتَّائِقُونَ إِلَىٰ وَلِيِّكَ
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
وَعَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱصْطَفَيْتَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ ٱلْبَرَرَةِ
مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ احَدٍ مِنْ اصْفِيَائِكَ
وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً لاََ غَايَةَ لِعَدَدِهَا
مَا نَنَالُ بِهِ سَعَةً مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ

content_item_translations.translation_text: All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.
May Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad His Prophet
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala sayyidina muhammadin nabiyyihi

content_item_translations.translation_text: and upon his Household and may He salute them with thorough salutation.
O Allah, all praise be to You
for Your decree that has been applied
to Your vicegerents whom You have purely selected for Yourself and Your religion;
content_item_translations.transliteration: fi awliya'ika alladhina istakhlastahum linafsika wa dinika

content_item_translations.translation_text: as You have chosen for them the abundance of what You have in possession;
that is the enduring pleasure
that neither vanishes nor diminishes,
content_item_translations.transliteration: alladhi la zawala lahu wa la idmihlala

content_item_translations.translation_text: after You had already stipulated on them to renounce
all the ranks of this lowly world
along with all of its embellishments and ornaments,
and they accepted this stipulation.
As You knew that they would fulfill this stipulation,
You accepted and drew them near to You.
You thus provided them with sublime mention
and obvious approval,
made Your angels descend to them,
honored them with Your revelations,
supported them with Your knowledge,
and made them the channel to You
and the means to winning Your pleasure.
Therefore, You made some of them dwell in Your Garden
until You decided to take him out of there.
You bore another one on in Your Ark
and saved him and those who believed with him
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa najjaytahu wa man amana ma`ahu

content_item_translations.translation_text: from perdition, out of Your mercy.
You took another one as Your intimate friend
and when he asked You to leave behind him a truthful mention, You responded to him
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa sa'alaka lisana sidqin fi al-akhirina fa'ajabtahu

content_item_translations.translation_text: and made that (mention) to be eminent.
You spoke to another one from a tree directly
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ba`dun kallamtahu min shajaratin takliman

content_item_translations.translation_text: and decided his brother to be his protector and representative.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ja`alta lahu min akhihi rid'an wa waziran

content_item_translations.translation_text: You made another one to be born without a father,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ba`dun awladtahu min ghayri abin

content_item_translations.translation_text: gave him clear-cut proofs
and aided him with the Sacred Spirit.
For each of them, You gave a code of law,
decided a certain course,
and finely chose successors;
well-trustworthy successors one after another,
each for a certain period,
in purpose of establishing Your religion
and acting as arguments against Your servants,
so that the truth should never leave its position
and the wrong should never overcome the people of the truth
and so that none should claim, saying,
“If only You had sent to us a warning messenger
and established for us a guiding person,
we should have followed Your signs before that we met humiliation and disgrace!”
content_item_translations.transliteration: fanattabi`a ayatika min qabli an nadhilla wa nakhza

content_item_translations.translation_text: You then ended the matter with Your most-beloved and well-select one, Muhammad,
content_item_translations.transliteration: ila an intahayta bil-amri ila habibika wa najibika muhammadin

content_item_translations.translation_text: may Allah bless him and his Household.
He was—as exactly as You have chosen—
the master of all those whom You created,
the best of all those whom You selected,
the most favorite of all those whom You pointed out,
and the noblest of all those on whom You decided.
So, You preferred him to Your prophets,
sent him to the two dependents (men and jinn) from Your servants,
enabled him to tread on the east and the west of Your lands,
made subservient to him the Buraq (the celestial sumpter),
raised his soul to Your heavens,
and entrusted with him the knowledge of whatever passed
and whatever shall come to pass up to the extinction of Your creatures.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ma yakunu ila inqida'i khalqika

content_item_translations.translation_text: You then granted him victory by means of awe & majesty
ordered (Archangels) Gabriel and Michael
as well as the marked angels to surround him,
and promised him to make his faith prevail all other faiths
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa wa`adtahu an tuzhira dinahu `ala alddini kullihi

content_item_translations.translation_text: however much the polytheists may be averse.
You did all that after You had settled him in an honest position among his people,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa dhalika ba`da an bawwa'tahu mubawwa'a sidqin min ahlihi

content_item_translations.translation_text: made for him and them the first house
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ja`alta lahu wa lahum awwala baytin

content_item_translations.translation_text: ever located for the people; that is the house in Bakkah,
blessed and guidance for the worlds.
In it, there are clear-cut proofs.
It is the standing-place of Abraham,
and whoever enters it will be secured.
You also said, “Allah only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qulta innama yuridu allahu liyudhhiba `ankum alrrijsa

content_item_translations.translation_text: O people of the House,
and to purify you a thorough purifying.”
You then decided the reward of Muhammad,
Your blessings be upon him and his Household,
to be the love for them; as in Your Book
You said, “Say: I do not ask of you any reward for it
but love for my near relatives.”
You also said, “Whatever reward I have asked of you, that is only for yourselves.”
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qulta ma sa'altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum

content_item_translations.translation_text: You also said, “I do not ask you aught in return
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qulta ma as'alukum `alayhi min ajrin

content_item_translations.translation_text: except that he who wills, may take the way to his Lord.”
content_item_translations.transliteration: illa man sha'a an yattakhidha ila rabbihi sabilan

content_item_translations.translation_text: They (i.e. the Prophet’s Household) have therefore been the way to You
and the course to Your pleasure.
When his (i.e. the Prophet) days passed,
he appointed as successor his vicegerent `Ali the son of Abu-Talib,
Your blessings be upon both of them and their Household,
because he (the Prophet) was the warner
and `Ali was the guide for every people.
So, he (the Prophet) said in the presence of the people,
“As for each one who has taken me as his master,
`Ali is now his master.
O Allah, guard any one who is loyal to `Ali,
be the enemy of any one who antagonizes him,
support any one who supports him,
and disappoint any one who disappoints him.”
He also said, “As for any one who has considered me as his Prophet, `Ali is now his commander.”
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qala man kuntu ana nabiyyahu fa`aliyyun amiruhu

content_item_translations.translation_text: He also said, “`Ali and I are of the same tree,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qala ana wa `aliyyun min shajaratin wahidatin

content_item_translations.translation_text: while all the other peoples are from various trees.”
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa sa'iru alnnasi min shajarin shatta

content_item_translations.translation_text: He endued him (i.e. `Ali) with the position that (Prophet) Aaron had with regard to (Prophet) Moses,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ahallahu mahalla haruna min musa

content_item_translations.translation_text: saying, “Your position to me is as same as Aaron’s position to Moses (in every thing)
content_item_translations.transliteration: faqal lahu anta minni bimanzilati haruna min musa

content_item_translations.translation_text: except that there shall be no prophet after me.”
He gave him in marriage his daughter the doyenne of the women of the worlds.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa zawwajahu ibnatahu sayyidata nisa'i al`alamina

content_item_translations.translation_text: He allowed him (alone) to do whatever he himself is allowed to do in his Mosque.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ahalla lahu min masjidihi ma halla lahu

content_item_translations.translation_text: He closed all the doors (to the Mosque) except his (i.e. `Ali) door.
He then entrusted with him his knowledge and his wisdom,
saying, “I am the city of knowledge,
and `Ali is its door.
So, whoever wants this city and wisdom,
must come to it from its door.”
He then said (to `Ali), “You are my brother, successor, and inheritor.
content_item_translations.transliteration: thumma qala anta akhi wa wasiyyi wa warithi

content_item_translations.translation_text: Your flesh is part of my flesh,
your blood is part of my blood,
your peace is my peace,
your war is my war,
and faith is mixed with your flesh and blood
as same as it is mixed with my flesh and blood.
On the morrow, you shall be my vicegerent on the (Divine) Pond.
You also settle my debts
and fulfill my commitments.
Your Shi`ah (i.e. adherents) shall be on pulpits of light,
white-faced, around me in Paradise.
They are my neighbors (therein).
Were it not for you `Ali,
true believers would not be recognized after me.”
Hence, he (i.e. `Ali), after the Prophet, was true guidance against straying off,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa kana ba`dahu hudan min alddalali

content_item_translations.translation_text: light against blindness,
the firmest rope of Allah,
and His straight path.
None would precede him in blood relation (with the Prophet)
or any priority in a religious affair,
and none would ever match him in any item of virtue.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa la yulhaqu fi manqabatin min manaqibihi

content_item_translations.translation_text: He patterned after the Messenger,
may Allah’s blessings be upon both of them and their Household.
He fought for the sake of true interpretation (of the Qur'an).
The blame of any blamer would never stop him from doing anything for the sake of Allah.
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa la ta'khudhuhu fi allahi lawmatu la'imin

content_item_translations.translation_text: He thus exterminated the villains of the Arabs,
killed their heroes,
and eradicated their ferocious fighters.
He therefore filled in their hearts with malice
from the battles of Badr, Khaybar, and Hunayn as well as others.
content_item_translations.transliteration: badriyyatan wa khaybariyyatan wa hunayniyyatan wa ghayrahunna

content_item_translations.translation_text: Therefore, they clang inseparably to opposing him
and attached upon dissenting him
until he had to kill the preachers, the unjust, and the apostates.
When he passed away
and he was killed by the most miserable of all of the late generations who will be attached to the most miserable of the past generations,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa qatalahu ashqa al-akhirina yatba`u ashqa al-awwalina

content_item_translations.translation_text: the decree of Allah’s Messenger,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
about the leadership of the successive guiding ones was not carried out;
rather, the people insisted on detesting him
and agreed unanimously on rupturing their relations with him
and moving away his descendants (from leadership),
except for a few ones who fulfilled the duty of observing their rights.
content_item_translations.transliteration: illa alqalila mimman wafa liri`ayati alhaqqi fihim

content_item_translations.translation_text: Many (of `Ali’s descendants) were therefore slain,
many others were taken as captives,
and many others were banished.
Decrees were thus applied to them
in a form expected to grant them excellent reward for that.
Verily, the earth is Allah’s;
He gives it in inheritance to whomever of His servants that He wishes;
and the end result shall be for the pious.
All glory be to our Lord.
Most certainly, the promise of our Lord shall come to pass.
Allah shall never fail to fulfill His promise.
He is the Almighty, the All-wise.
For the immaculate ones from the household of Muhammad and `Ali,
content_item_translations.transliteration: fa`ala al-ata'ibi min ahli bayti muhammadin wa `aliyyin

content_item_translations.translation_text: may Allah bless both of them and their household,
let weepers weep.
For them too, let lamenters lament.
For the like of them, let tears be shed,
screamers scream,
yellers yell,
and wailers wail.
Where is al-Hasan? Where is al-Husayn?
Where are the sons of al-Husayn;
a virtuous one after another,
and a veracious one after another?
Where is the course (to Allah) after a course?
Where is the best after the best?
Where are the rising suns?
Where are the shining moons?
Where are the brilliant stars?
Where are the authorities of the religion
and the foundations of knowledge?
Where is the left by Allah
that is always represented by individuals from the guiding (Prophetic) offspring?
content_item_translations.transliteration: allati la takhlu min al`itrati alhadiyati

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the one prepared for cutting off the roots of the wrongdoers?
Where is the one awaited for mending every unevenness and crookedness?
Where is the one hoped for removing oppression and aggression?
Where is the one spared for refreshing the duties and traditions?
Where is the one chosen for restoring the faith and the code of law?
Where is the one expected to restore to life the Book and its provisions?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna almu'ammalu li'ihya'i alkitabi wa hududihi

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the reviver of the elements of the religion and its people?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna muhyi ma`alimi alddini wa ahlihi

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the one shattering the arms of the aggressors?
Where is the one demolishing the edifices of polytheism and hypocrisy?
Where is the one annihilating the people of wickedness,
disobedience, and tyranny?
Where is the one uprooting the branches of error and insurgence?
Where is the one effacing the traces of evasiveness and personal desires?
Where is the one severing the ropes of fabrication and forgery?
Where is the one terminating the insolent defiant and persistent rebels?
Where is the one tearing up the people of obstinacy, misleading, and atheism?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna musta'silu ahli al`inadi walttadlili wal-ilhadi

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the one ennobling the saints and humiliating the enemies?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna mu`izzu al-awliya'i wa mudhillu al-a`da'i

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the one bringing together (all scattered) words to piety?
Where is the door of Allah from which Allah is come?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna babu allahi alladhi minhu yu'ta

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the Face of Allah towards whom the saints turn their faces.
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna wajhu allahi alladhi ilayhi yatawajjahu al-awliya'u

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the means of access that is connectedly extended between the earth and the heavens.
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna alssababu almuttasilu bayna al-ardi walssama'i

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the patron of the Conquest Day
and the stretcher of the pennon of true guidance?
Where is the one reunifying the dispersed parts of uprightness and contentment?
Where is the one demanding with the vengeance of the Prophets and their sons?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna alttalibu bidhuhuli al-anbiya'i wa abna'i al-anbiya'i

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the one demanding with the blood of the one slain in Karbala'?
Where is the one granted aid against whomever transgresses and forges lies against him?
Where is the distressed who is answered when he prays?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna almudtarru alladhi yujabu idha da`a

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the forepart of the creatures who enjoys dutifulness and piety?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ayna sadru alkhala'iqi dhu albirri walttaqwa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Where is the son of the well-chosen Prophet,
the son of `Ali the well-pleased,
the son of Khadijah the glittery lady,
and the son of Fatimah the grand lady?
May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
May my soul be protection and shield for you.
O son of the chiefs drawn near!
O son of the most honorable, outstanding ones!
O son of the guiding and well-guided ones!
O son of the ever-best refined ones!
O son of the all-liberal and all-select ones!
O son of the immaculate and purified ones!
O son of the ample-giving, finely elected ones!
O son of the bounteous, most honorable ones!
O son of light-giving full moons!
O son of beaming lanterns!
O son of piercing flames!
O son of luminous stars!
O son of patent ways!
O son of obvious signs!
O son of perfect knowledge!
O son of renowned traditions!
O son of well-established features!
O son of well-known miracles!
O son of widely witnessed demonstrations!
O son of the straight path!
O son of the great news!
O son of him who is elevated and full of wisdom in the original of the Book with Allah.
content_item_translations.transliteration: yabna man huwa fi ummi alkitabi lada allahi `aliyyun hakimun

content_item_translations.translation_text: O son of signs and manifestations!
O son of apparent points of evidence!
O son of clear-cut and dazzling substantiations!
O son of conclusive arguments!
O son of superabundant bounties!
O son of Taha and the decisive (verses)!
O son of Yasin and al-Dhariyat (the winnowing winds)!
O son of al-Tur (the Mount of Revelation) and al-`ªdiyat (the running steeds)!
O son of him who drew near and then bowed;
he therefore was the measure of two bows or closer still;
nearness and closeness to the Most High and Most Exalted (Lord)!
How I wonder! Where has farness taken you?
content_item_translations.transliteration: layta shi`ri ayna istaqarrat bika alnnawa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Or which land or soil is carrying you?
content_item_translations.transliteration: bal ayya ardin tuqilluka aw thara

content_item_translations.translation_text: Is it on (Mount) Radwa or elsewhere on (Mount) Dhi-Tuwa?
content_item_translations.transliteration: abiradwa aw ghayriha am dhi tuwa

content_item_translations.translation_text: It is hard for me that I can see all creatures but I can neither see you
content_item_translations.transliteration: `azizun `alayya an ara alkhalqa wa la tura

content_item_translations.translation_text: nor can I hear any whisper or confidential talk from you!
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa la asma`u laka hasisan wa la najwa

content_item_translations.translation_text: It is hard for me that ordeals encompass you, not me
and neither cry nor complaint from me can rally round you!
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa la yanaluka minni dajijun wa la shakwa

content_item_translations.translation_text: May my soul be ransom for you; for although you are hidden from us, you have never forsaken us.
content_item_translations.transliteration: binafsi anta min mughayyabin lam yakhlu minna

content_item_translations.translation_text: May my soul be ransom for you; for although you are away, you have never been away from us.
content_item_translations.transliteration: binafsi anta min nazihin ma nazaha `anna

content_item_translations.translation_text: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are the wish of an eager
believing man or woman who mention you and miss you.
content_item_translations.transliteration: min mu'minin wa mu'minatin dhakara fahanna

content_item_translations.translation_text: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are an unmatched pioneer of dignity.
May my soul be ransom for you; for you are an unrivaled origin of glory.
content_item_translations.transliteration: binafsi anta min athili majdin la yujara

content_item_translations.translation_text: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are unparalleled center of bounties.
content_item_translations.transliteration: binafsi anta min tiladi ni`amin la tudaha

content_item_translations.translation_text: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are unequaled in all-inclusive honor.
content_item_translations.transliteration: binafsi anta min nasifi sharafin la yusawa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Until when will I be bewildered about you, O my master, and until when?
content_item_translations.transliteration: ila mata aharu fika ya mawlaya wa ila mata

content_item_translations.translation_text: In what kind of statement and in what kind of talk can I describe you?
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa ayya khitabin asifu fika wa ayya najwa

content_item_translations.translation_text: It is hard for me that I can receive answers and words, but you cannot.
It is hard for me that I weep for you but the others disappoint you.
It is hard for me that what has happened afflict you other than all the others.
Is there any helper with whom I may lament and bewail as much as I wish?
content_item_translations.transliteration: hal min mu`inin fa'utila ma`ahu al`awila walbuka'a

content_item_translations.translation_text: Is there any aggrieved one whom I can help in grief when he becomes tired?
content_item_translations.transliteration: hal min jazu`in fa'usa`ida jaza`ahu idha khala

content_item_translations.translation_text: Is there any eye moling out and thus my eye may help it to mol out more?
Is there any way to meet you, O son of Ahmad (the Prophet)?
content_item_translations.transliteration: hal ilayka yabna ahmada sabilun fatulqa

content_item_translations.translation_text: Will our day be promised to catch your day and we will thus achieve our hope?
content_item_translations.transliteration: hal yattasilu yawmuna minka bi`idatin fanahza

content_item_translations.translation_text: When will we be able to join your refreshing springs and we will then be satiated?
When will we quench our thirst from your fresh water,
because thirst has been too long?
When will we accompany you in coming and going so that our eyes will be delighted?
When will you see us and we see you spreading the pennon of victory?
content_item_translations.transliteration: mata tarana wa naraka wa qad nasharta liwa'a alnnasri tura

content_item_translations.translation_text: Can it be that we surround you while you are leading the groups,
content_item_translations.transliteration: atarana nahuffu bika wa anta ta'ummu almala'a

content_item_translations.translation_text: after you will have filled in the earth with justice,
tasted your enemies humiliation and punishment,
annihilated the insolent defiant and the deniers of the truth,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa abarta al`utata wa jahadata alhaqqi

content_item_translations.translation_text: cut off the roots of the arrogant,
eradicated the sources of the wrongdoers,
and we keep on saying, “All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds?”
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa nahnu naqulu alhamdu lillahi rabbi al`alamina

content_item_translations.translation_text: O Allah, You are verily the reliever from agonies and ordeals.
To You do I complain about the transgressions against me, for You alone are worthy of receiving complaints,
and You are alone the Lord of the Hereafter and this world.
So, (please) aid Your agonized worthless servant, O Aide of those who seek aid,
grant him (i.e. Your servant) chance to see his master, O Lord of mighty prowess,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa arihi sayyidahu ya shadida alquwa

content_item_translations.translation_text: remove from him misfortune and anguish, in the name of his master,
and satisfy his thirst, O He Who is established on the Throne
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa barrid ghalilahu ya man `ala al`arshi istawa

content_item_translations.translation_text: and He to Whom is the return and the final goal.
O Allah, we are Your servants who are fervently willing to meet Your vicegerent,
content_item_translations.transliteration: allahumma wa nahnu `abiduka altta'iquna ila waliyyika

content_item_translations.translation_text: who reminds of You and Your Prophet;
and whom You have created as haven and refuge for us,
You have appointed as foundation and source of protection for us,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa aqamtahu lana qiwaman wa ma`adhan

content_item_translations.translation_text: and whom You have made to be the leader of the believers among us.
So, (please) convey to him greetings and salutations from us,
endue us with more honor, O my Lord, through that,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa zidna bidhalika ya rabbi ikraman

content_item_translations.translation_text: decide his settlement among us to be settlement and dwelling for us,
content_item_translations.transliteration: waj`al mustaqarrahu lana mustaqarran wa muqaman

content_item_translations.translation_text: and perfect Your bounty by making him occupy the leading position before us
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa atmim ni`mataka bitaqdimika iyyahu amamana

content_item_translations.translation_text: so that You shall allow us to enter the gardens of Your Paradise
and to accompany the martyrs from among Your elite ones.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad;([1])
content_item_translations.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

content_item_translations.translation_text: and send blessings upon Muhammad his grandfather and Your messenger;
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin jaddihi wa rasulika

content_item_translations.translation_text: the senior master,
upon his father the junior master,
upon his grandmother the grand veracious lady
Fatimah the daughter of Muhammad,
peace be upon him and his Household,
upon his dutiful fathers whom You have chosen (over all others),
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa `ala man istafayta min aba'ihi albararati

content_item_translations.translation_text: and upon him with such most favorable, most perfect,
most thorough, most permanent,
most abundant, and most plentiful
blessings that You have ever sent upon any of Your elite ones
and well-chosen ones among Your creatures.
And (please) bless him with such blessings whose number is infinite,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa salli `alayhi salatan la ghayata li`adadiha

content_item_translations.translation_text: whose quantity is never-ending,
and whose time is interminable.
O Allah! Through him, establish all rights,
refute the entire wrong,
grant triumph to Your loyalists,
humiliate Your enemies,
establish, O Allah, between him and us
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa sil allahumma baynana wa baynahu

content_item_translations.translation_text: a connection that leads us to accompany his ancestors,
include us with those who will take their vengeance
and keep constant under their shadow,
help us fulfill our duties towards him,
exert all efforts in obedience to him
and avoiding disobeying him,
bestow upon us with the favor of attaining his pleasure,
and grant us his kindness, mercy,
content_item_translations.transliteration: wa hab lana ra'fatahu wa rahmatahu

content_item_translations.translation_text: prayer (for us), and his goodness
in an amount due to which we will gain a good deal of Your mercy
content_item_translations.transliteration: ma nanalu bihi sa`atan min rahmatika

content_item_translations.translation_text: and achievement with You.
And, through him, render our prayers admitted,
our sins forgiven,
and our supplications responded.
And, through him too, make our sustenance expanded for us,
our distresses relieved,
and our needs granted.
And (please) receive us with Your Noble Face,
approve of our seeking nearness to You,
and have a merciful look at us
by which we will win perfect honor with You;
and, after that, do not ever take it away from us, in the name of Your magnanimity,
and give us a drink from the Pond of his grandfather,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
from his own cup and with his own hand,
such a replete, satiating,
pleasant, and wholesome drink
after which we shall never suffer from thirst.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!
